name: vLLM#53328: FP4 warning incorrectly blames GPU when checkpoint is weight-only
notes: prepare_nvfp4_moe_layer_for_marlin() warns 'GPU does not have native FP4 support' even when GPU supports FP4 but checkpoint is weight-only (W4A16). Warning is false on Jetson Thor (SM110). PR gates warning on cutlass_fp4_supported(). Demonstrates misleading error messages in quantization.
